d: DMK Women’s Wing organized district-capital protests across Tamil Nadu focusing on women's safety, child protection, and inflation. Speaking at the demonstration, DMK MP Kanimozhi criticized Chief Minister Joseph Vijay—who holds the Home portfolio—for failing to address deteriorating law and order, rising violent crimes, and instances of child trafficking. Launching the "Wake up Vijay" campaign, Kanimozhi highlighted public hardships due to skyrocketing prices of essential commodities like rice, cooking oil, and vegetables ahead of the festive season, alongside escalating electricity bills…
